workflow_runs.name: Lumo change review
workflow_runs.display_title: LUMO 0.13.8+2020: reviewed 3D worlds, Lumo animation and Android integration

head_commit.message:
fix(connect-four): keep 48dp controls aligned through real scrolling

Share board/control geometry and scroll offset, adapt board height for short
landscape views and retain a scrollable portrait layout for large text.
Preserve all game rules, native sessions, save logic and reviewed Native pin.

Make existing flow/visual tests wait for the actual MissingPlugin fallback;
retain their game/reward and strict alignment assertions. Add real two-way
swipe, exposed target and exact manual-piece checks on four small layouts.
Run the concrete regressions early without weakening any existing gate.

Dart source parser and 8 workflow contracts passed locally. Corrected Flutter
execution remains pending CI after local runtime/cache recovery failure.
